<thought>To find the required template, I will first retrieve the list of available functional groups to know the exact names used by the system. Then I will search the template catalog for a reaction that forms a C‑C bond and a C‑O bond, breaks a C‑O bond, forms an ether oxygen, and breaks aromatic hydroxyl and ketone groups, using the flavanone product SMILES as the target molecule. This should return the appropriate template ID and its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
